messages:
Alice SRE: Heads up — customer acme-inc reporting 403 KMSDecrypt after our key rotation ~1h ago. They hit the API: Decrypt failed AccessDenied. CloudTrail shows some Decrypt events with encryptionContext missing.
Jamal: Can you paste correlation id and a sample error? Also whether the CMK is AWS KMS or HSM-backed. Sounds like encryptionContext mismatch or stale grants.
Maria Support: Correlation id 2f8b9e3c. Sample error: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt". Customer is on our private VPC deployment. DEKs are stored encrypted in their DB; we rotated via alias swap.
Chris Infra: My hunch — alias swap moved alias to new key while DB still holds ciphertexts encrypted with old key id. If DEKs reference old key id, decrypts to new key will fail unless grant exists.
Alice SRE: Running quick check — DB shows dek_kms_key_id = arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/old-key-id for many rows. Alias now points to new-key-id.
Jamal: Repro steps for us: 1) pull a DEK ciphertext from DB, 2) try `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob --encryption-context tenant_id=acme` -> should fail against new key. 3) try against old key -> should succeed if grant present.
Maria Support: I ran decrypt against new key and got AccessDenied. Decrypt against old key succeeded. Old key still has grants listed.
Chris Infra: Short mitigation runbook:
```
# temporarily point alias back to old key
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/tenant-acme --target-key-id old-key-id
# verify decrypts work
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek_blob --encryption-context tenant_id=acme
# once restored, run re-encrypt worker
for dek in $(list-deks); do
  aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://$dek --encryption-context tenant_id=acme > dek_plain
  aws kms encrypt --key-id new-key-id --plaintext fileb://dek_plain --encryption-context tenant_id=acme > dek_new
  update-db --id $dek_id --dek $dek_new
done
# then point alias to new key again and remove old grants
```
Jamal: Also noticed CloudTrail entries with empty encryptionContext — some older client SDK version 1.2.0 strips enc ctx in a retry path. Recommend customer upgrade to 1.2.3 or later.
Alice SRE: Action items: (1) request customer approval for 30m alias rollback window (Maria), (2) Chris to run re-encrypt job, (3) Jamal to prepare post-rotation checklist (pre-rotation scan + client SDK check), (4) record in audit logs for compliance.
Maria Support: Reached out to CSM, customer approved rollback window. Scheduling now.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 created, severity P2. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-reencrypt
Chris Infra: After re-encrypt, ensure key policies include expected service principals and add a check to rotation pipeline: fail rotation if any DB row references old key id. Also add an automated test that verifies encryptionContext presence in client telemetry.
Jamal: Postmortem notes — root cause: alias swap without migrating persisted ciphertexts + subset of clients not providing encryptionContext. Prevent: add pre-rotation scan, client validation, and a migration tool. :thumbsup:
Alice SRE: Thanks team, I'll follow up with postmortem once incident closed.
